3767.commentary: (VINa) anabhirato'ti vikkhittacitto kāmarāgapariḷāhena pariḍayhamāno na pana gihibhāvaṃ patthayamāno.

examples.text: asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā, aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā, nirodhasaññā

tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi, addhā ime āyasmanto anabhiratā vā brahmacariyaṃ caranti, atthi vā tesaṃ kiñci pāpaṃ kammaṃ kataṃ paṭicchannaṃ, tathā hi ime āyasmanto kisā lūkhā dubbaṇṇā uppaṇḍ'uppaṇḍukajātā dhamanisanthatagattā, na viya maññe cakkhuṃ bandhanti janassa dassanāyā'ti.

3768.meaning1: recognition of non-delight (in); perception of dissatisfaction (with); concept of non-indulgence
3768.commentary: (ANa) sabbaloke anabhiratisaññā'ti sabbasmiṃ tedhātusannivese loke ukkaṇṭhitassa uppajjanakasaññā.
3768.notes: ten peceptions 1. aniccasaññā, 2. anattasaññā, 3. asubhasaññā, 4. ādīnavasaññā, 5. pahānasaññā, 6. virāgasaññā, 7. nirodhasaññā, 8. sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā, 9. sabbasaṅkhāresu anicchāsaññā, 10. ānāpānassati.

examples.text: pañc'imā, bhikkhave, saññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā honti mah'ānisaṃsā amat'ogadhā amatapariyosānā. katamā pañca? asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, ādīnavasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā.
katamā dasa? aniccasaññā, anattasaññā, asubhasaññā, ādīnavasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā, nirodhasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā, sabbasaṅkhāresu anicchāsaññā, ān'āpānassati.

3769.meaning1: fortified by the perception of dissatisfaction (with)

examples.text: sabbaloke anabhiratasaññāparicitena cetasā bahulaṃ viharato lokacitresu cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativattati, na sampasāriyati upekkhā vā pāṭikulyatā vā saṇṭhāti.

3770.commentary: (ANa) sabbaloke anabhiratisaññī'ti sabbasmim'pi tedhātuke lokasannivāse anabhiratāya ukkaṇṭhitasaññāya samannāgato.

examples.text: etha, tumhe, bhikkhave, asubh'ānupassino kāye viharatha, āhāre paṭikūlasaññino, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññino, sabbasaṅkhāresu anicc'ānupassino'ti.

3771.grammar: fem, abstr, from na abhirati, neg (+loc)
3771.commentary: (ANa) sabbaloke anabhiratisaññaṃ bhāvetī'ti sabbasmim'pi tedhātuke loke anabhiratisaññaṃ ukkaṇṭhitasaññaṃ bhāvetī'ti attho.

examples.text: taṃ kut'ettha labbhā yaṃ me paro anabhiratiṃ vinodetvā abhiratiṃ uppādeyya
alābhā vata me, na vata me lābhā, dulladdhaṃ vata me, na vata me suladdhaṃ, yassa me anabhirati uppannā, rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti,

3774.meaning1: concept of disenchantment (with); perception of non-delight (in)
3774.commentary: (ANa) sabbaloke anabhiratisaññaṃ bhāvetī'ti sabbasmim'pi tedhātuke loke anabhiratisaññaṃ ukkaṇṭhitasaññaṃ bhāvetī'ti attho.

examples.text: katame nava dhammā uppādetabbā? nava saññā, asubhasaññā, maraṇasaññā, āhāre paṭikūlasaññā, sabbaloke anabhiratisaññā, aniccasaññā, anicce dukkhasaññā, dukkhe anattasaññā, pahānasaññā, virāgasaññā.

3775.commentary: (ANa) sabbaloke anabhiratisaññī'ti sabbasmim'pi tedhātuke lokasannivāse anabhiratāya ukkaṇṭhitasaññāya samannāgato.

examples.text: atha kho te, pāpima, bhikkhū kakusandhena bhagavatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena evaṃ ovadiyamānā evaṃ anusāsiyamānā araññagatā'pi rukkhamūlagatā'pi suññ'āgāragatā'pi asubh'ānupassino kāye vihariṃsu, āhāre paṭikūlasaññino, sabbaloke anabhiratisaññino, sabbasaṅkhāresu anicc'ānupassino.

3777.commentary: (VINa) anabhiraddho'ti na sukhito na vā pasādito'ti anabhiraddho.

examples.text: duṭṭho doso'ti kupito anattamano anabhiraddho āhatacitto khilajāto.

3778.commentary: (VINa) tāya ca anabhiraddhiyā'ti yāya anabhiraddho'ti vutto. imehi dvīhi vedanākkhandhaṃ dasseti.

examples.text: appatīto'ti tena ca kopena tena ca dosena tāya ca anattamanatāya tāya ca anabhiraddhiyā appatīto hoti.
tatra ce, bhikkhave, pare tathāgataṃ akkosanti paribhāsanti rosenti vihesenti, tatra, bhikkhave, tathāgatassa na hoti āghāto na appaccayo na cetaso anabhiraddhi.

3779.grammar: prp of na abhiramati, neg, intrans (+loc)

3780.grammar: ger of na abhisaṅkharoti, neg, trans (+acc)
3780.meaning1: not constructing; not generating; not fabricating
3780.construction:
na > an + abhi + saṃ + kharo + tya
na + abhisaṅkhacca

examples.text: tadappatiṭṭhitaṃ viññāṇaṃ avirūḷhaṃ anabhisaṅkhacca vimuttaṃ. vimuttattā ṭhitaṃ. ṭhitattā santusitaṃ. santusitattā na paritassati. aparitassaṃ paccattaññ'eva parinibbāyati.

3781.grammar: abs of na abhisaṅkharoti, neg, trans (+acc)
3781.meaning1: having not constructed; having not generated; having not fabricated
3781.construction:
na > an + abhi + saṃ + √kar > khar + itvā
an + abhisaṅkharitvā

examples.text: te jātisaṃvattanike'pi saṅkhāre anabhisaṅkharitvā, jarāsaṃvattanike'pi saṅkhāre anabhisaṅkharitvā… jātipapātam'pi nappapatanti, jarāpapātam'pi nappapatanti

3782.grammar: prp of na abhisaṅkharoti, neg, trans (+acc)
3782.meaning1: not creating; not imagining; not forming ideas
3782.construction: na > an + abhi + saṃ + kharo + nta

examples.text: so n'eva taṃ abhisaṅkharoti, na abhisañcetayati bhavāya vā vibhavāya vā. so anabhisaṅkharonto anabhisañcetayanto bhavāya vā vibhavāya vā na kiñci loke upādiyati, anupādiyaṃ na paritassati, aparitassaṃ paccattaṃ'y'eva parinibbāyati.
tassa acetayato anabhisaṅkharoto tā c'eva saññā nirujjhanti, aññā ca oḷārikā saññā na uppajjanti. so nirodhaṃ phusati. evaṃ kho, poṭṭhapāda, anupubb'ābhisaññānirodha-sampajāna-samāpatti hoti.

3783.grammar: prp of na abhisañcetayati, neg, intrans (+dat)
3783.meaning1: not thinking (about); not devising (for); not planning (for)
3783.construction: na > an + abhi + saṃ + cetaya + nta

examples.text: so n'eva taṃ abhisaṅkharoti, na abhisañcetayati bhavāya vā vibhavāya vā. so anabhisaṅkharonto anabhisañcetayanto bhavāya vā vibhavāya vā na kiñci loke upādiyati, anupādiyaṃ na paritassati, aparitassaṃ paccattaṃ'y'eva parinibbāyati.

3784.grammar: prp of na abhisaddahati, neg, trans (+acc)
3784.meaning1: not truly believing; not having total trust; not having complete confidence; without complete conviction (in)
3784.construction: na > an + abhi + sad + daha + nta

examples.text: yo dussīlo sīlavantesu dadāti dānaṃ, adhammena laddhaṃ appasannacitto, anabhisaddahaṃ kammaphalaṃ uḷāraṃ, sā dakkhiṇā paṭiggāhakato visujjhati.
avijjā'ti dukkhe aññāṇaṃ… yaṃ evarūpaṃ aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ anabhisamayo ananubodho asambodho appaṭivedho asaṃgāhanā apariyogāhanā asamapekkhanā

3786.grammar: ger of na abhisameti, neg, trans (+acc)
3786.construction:
na > an + abhi + saṃ + e + tya
na + abhisamecca

examples.text: yo, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya, ahaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ anabhisamecca, dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ anabhisamecca, dukkhanirodhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ anabhisamecca, dukkhanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yathābhūtaṃ anabhisamecca sammā dukkhass'antaṃ karissāmī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

3787.construction: na > an + abhi + saṃ + e + ta

examples.text: ādittaṃ, bhikkhave, celaṃ vā sīsaṃ vā ajjhupekkhitvā amanasikaritvā anabhisametānaṃ catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisamayāya adhimatto chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhī ca appaṭivānī ca sati ca sampajaññañ'ca karaṇīyaṃ. katamesaṃ catunnaṃ?

3788.meaning1: not gained full awakening; not woken completely

examples.text: pubb'eva me, bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattass'eva sato etadahosi, ko nu kho rūpassa assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ?

mayham'pi kho, mahānāma, pubb'eva sambodhā, anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattass'eva sato, app'assādā kāmā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo'ti, evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ hoti

3789.meaning1: not fully understood; not completely realized

examples.text: sammāsambuddhassa te paṭijānato ime dhammā anabhisambuddhā'ti.

3790.commentary: (DNa) anabhisambhavanīyo'ti apattabbo, na taṃ devā tāvatiṃsā passantī'ti attho.

examples.text: yo kho pana, bhante, brahmuno pakativaṇṇo anabhisambhavanīyo so devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ cakkhupathasmiṃ.

3791.grammar: prp of na abhisambhavati, neg, trans (+acc)
3791.construction: na > an + abhi + saṃ + bhava + nta

examples.text: taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti.

3792.grammar: prp of na abhisambhuṇāti, neg, trans (+acc)
3792.meaning1: not reaching; not attaining; not realizing

3793.grammar: prp of na abhisambhuṇāti, neg, trans (+acc)
3793.meaning1: being unable to endure; being incapable (of)

examples.text: idha, ambaṭṭha, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā imaññ'eva anuttaraṃ vijjācaraṇasampadaṃ anabhisambhuṇamāno khārividham'ādāya araññ'āyatanaṃ ajjhogāhati, pavattaphalabhojano bhavissāmī'ti. so añña'd'atthu vijjācaraṇasampannass'eva paricārako sampajjati.

3795.commentary: (ANa) ābhiseko'ti abhisekaṃ kātuṃ yutto. anabhisitto'ti na tāva abhisitto.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo āsaṃso? idha, bhikkhave, rañño khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa jeṭṭho putto hoti ābhiseko anabhisitto acalappatto. so suṇāti, itthan'nāmo kira khattiyo khattiyehi khattiy'ābhisekena abhisitto'ti.

3796.meaning1: with no supreme lord; without a divine protector
3796.meaning2: without a companion; without a helper
3796.commentary: (MNa) anabhissaro'ti asaraṇo abhisaritvā abhigantvā assāsetuṃ samatthena virahito.

examples.text: atāṇo loko anabhissaro'ti kho, mahārāja, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dutiyo dhamm'uddeso uddiṭṭho, yam'ahaṃ ñatvā ca disvā sutvā ca agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.

3797.grammar: prp of na abhivadati, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: tañ'ce bhikkhu n'ābhinandati n'ābhivadati n'ājjhosāya tiṭṭhati, tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nirujjhati nandī. nandinirodhā dukkhanirodho, puṇṇā'ti vadāmi

3798.grammar: prp of na abhi √his, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: so dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ anabhihiṃsamāno vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
anamataggo'yaṃ, bhikkhave, saṃsāro. pubbā koṭi nappaññāyati sattippahārānaṃ asippahārānaṃ usuppahārānaṃ pharasuppahārānaṃ
saddhassa hi, bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhavīriyassa upaṭṭhitassatino samāhitacittassa etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ evaṃ pajānissati, anamataggo kho saṃsāro.
